description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'ModulesAPITest' that extends endpoint integration test framework to verify the behavior of the 'ModulesAPI' within the OrangeHRM application. It includes setup, test cases for fetching all modules, updating modules, and placeholders for create, get one, and delete operations, with some dependencies and mock services setup.
